summary.intent: Deploy v0.25.0 to staging after a release PR merge, then investigate and fix two staging issues (slow IPNS publish and broken token refresh), and consolidate the web app's fragmented HTTP client architecture.
summary.outcome: v0.25.1 was tagged and deployed to staging after fixing a Dockerfile regression and a release-please title pattern misconfiguration; a fire-and-forget fix for IPNS DHT publish latency was merged via PR #308; and a large refactor consolidating three HTTP client paths into one via @cipherbox/api-client was opened in PR #309.

repo: The staging deployment workflow (deploy-staging.yml) triggers on tags matching 'v*-staging*', not release tags — staging deployment is intentionally a manual step via the 'Tag Staging Release' action.

release-please's pull-request-title-pattern was missing '${component}', causing it to fail to match merged release PRs to components in a multi-package monorepo config, blocking all subsequent releases.
The API is a zero-knowledge server that never handles plaintext or encryption — it stores opaque blobs, manages auth, and proxies IPFS, so it intentionally has no workspace package dependencies.

The web app had three separate HTTP client paths: orval react-query generated client (fetch), a hand-written axios client for login/vault init, and bare axios/fetch for IPFS — none with consistent 401/refresh handling.

The orval react-query generation produced ~8,800 lines of hooks that were almost entirely unused — only useHealthControllerCheck was actually consumed as a hook; everything else called the raw generated functions directly.

@cipherbox/api-client uses orval with 'axios-functions' client mode for framework-agnostic use by SDK/desktop; the web app had a duplicate orval config with 'react-query' mode that was largely redundant.

IPNS DHT publish via someguy sidecar takes 10-30s but is unnecessary to await — the DB record is the authoritative source and resolveRecord() always prefers DB cache, making DHT propagation purely best-effort.

code.finding: The 'result' variable stayed 'success' after making DHT publish fire-and-forget — correct behavior since from the API's perspective the publish succeeded once the DB record was saved.

Had a stale COPY of packages/crypto/package.json that was no longer needed (API has no workspace deps) but caused pnpm deploy to fail when @cipherbox/crypto's transitive devDep @cipherbox/core couldn't be found in the build context.

Orval-generated fetch mutator for react-query had zero 401 handling, while token refresh interceptor only existed on the separate axios client — causing silent auth failures after 15-minute access token expiry.

pull-request-title-pattern set to 'chore: release' without '${component}', causing release-please to abort with 'untagged, merged release PRs outstanding' in multi-package mode because it couldn't match PR back to components.

workflow: release-please 'chore' commit type does not trigger a version bump — use 'fix' or 'feat' to get release-please to open a new release PR.
When release-please is stuck due to untagged PRs, manually creating the git tag and GitHub release from the correct commit unblocks it without corrupting its state.
Grafana Cloud free-tier instances hibernate and return HTTP 503 'instance is loading' on first request after inactivity — transient, re-run the failed job.
The Tag Staging Release action checks out the release tag's commit, so a fix merged after the tag requires a new patch release tag rather than just re-running the action against the old tag.

friction: release-please's 'untagged merged PRs' abort blocked v0.25.1 tag creation even though all component tags existed — required manual tag + release creation to unblock staging.
Three separate HTTP client paths in the web app with inconsistent auth handling meant token refresh was silently broken for the majority of API calls — only exposed by a long-running batch operation.
The stale packages/crypto COPY in the API Dockerfile was a latent bug that only surfaced when the expanded package list caused pnpm to resolve transitive devDependencies it couldn't find.
Copilot review comments on PR #308 required a branch switch mid-session to address before merge.
open_items: PR #309 (refactor/consolidate-api-client) is open and needs review/merge — removes ~8,800 lines of generated react-query code and unifies auth/token-refresh into @cipherbox/api-client.
PR #307 (fix release-please title pattern) needs merge to prevent future release-please aborts in the multi-package setup.

Token refresh fix from the debugger investigation was stashed/superseded by the api-client consolidation refactor — needs to be verified that PR #309 correctly handles the 401 refresh scenario end-to-end.
The Tag Staging Release workflow for v0.25.1 was triggered but had a transient Grafana provisioning failure — may need a re-run of just the provisioning step after the workflow completes.
IPNS publish latency fix (PR #308) addresses the await issue but the underlying someguy sidecar configuration may still warrant investigation if DHT propagation reliability matters.
